Lumion is building an AI-first platform that unifies software and processes for trade and technical schools. The Junior Full Stack Software Engineer will contribute to backend business logic, data models, APIs, integrations, administrative workflows, customer-facing interfaces, and automated tests as part of the engineering team.

Required
**A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science is required.** The degree must be completed before your employment begins. Current students may apply if they will graduate before their start date
**Evidence that you have put your programming skills into practice.** This can come from a capstone, internship, personal project, open source contribution, research project, freelance engagement, or another hands on project. We want to understand what you worked on, what you personally contributed, and what you learned
**Confidence in at least one programming language.** You can build with it, debug it, and explain the logic behind your decisions. The language does not need to be PHP, and prior Laravel experience is not required
**An understanding of web development fundamentals.** You are familiar with concepts such as HTTP, APIs, authentication, databases, browser interfaces, version control, and automated testing
**Logical problem solving.** You can break an unfamiliar problem into manageable parts, investigate failures systematically, and work toward the underlying cause
**Product judgment.** You consider the person using the software and connect technical decisions to the problem being solved
You must reside in and be authorized to work in the United States
Your normal workday must overlap by at least six hours with our Salt Lake City team
